P3.why_it_matters_for_us: The vendor's own text says (a) re-posing and re-tracing per step is the ACCURATE route - which is exactly what pose_articulated() does, so our method is the documented high-accuracy path, not a hack; and (b) the one-velocity-vector shortcut is valid only for 'trajectory lengths ... not exceeding a few wavelengths'. A 10.55 cm blade tip at ~6000 rpm travels ~0.066 m in 1 ms; at 3.5 GHz (lambda=8.6 cm) that is already ~0.8 lambda per millisecond and the tip path is curved, so a rotor blade blows the stated bound within one OFDM slot. papers.title: Super-Resolution Experimental Validation and Polarimetric Extension of the Effective Roughness Diffuse Scattering Models

P8.verdict: ⭐⭐ THE EXTERNAL RECIPROCITY STANDARD WE ASKED FOR. It states the reciprocity condition on a scattering pattern as a formula, names the model family that violates it, and names the fix - and it says Sionna RT ships the family.

quotes.q: While this model captures the directional spreading of diffuse scattering around the specular direction, it does not satisfy reciprocity, i.e., invariance of the scattering response when the incident and observation directions are interchanged [27].
To ensure physical consistency, the reciprocity condition must be satisfied, which can be expressed as f(k_s, k_i)/F(k_i) * cos(theta_i) = f(k_i, k_s)/F(k_s) * cos(theta_s).   (5)

The reciprocal effective roughness (RER) model satisfies this condition by modifying the directive pattern as [8] f_RER(k_s,k_i) = sqrt(cos(theta_s)) * ((1+cos(psi))/2)^alpha_R.   (6) This formulation preserves the ER lobe structure while ensuring reciprocity through the inclusion of the sqrt(cos(theta_s)) factor.
The popularity of the model is supported by its integration in several ray tracing (RT) tools, including NVIDIA's Sionna RT [21], Remcom's Wireless InSite [22], and Siradel's Volcano [23].

chain_of_citations_for_us: [27] J. G. Van Bladel, Electromagnetic Fields, 2nd ed., IEEE Press/Wiley 2007 - the reciprocity principle itself
[7] V. Degli-Esposti, F. Fuschini, E. M. Vitucci, G. Falciasecca, IEEE TAP 55(1) 2007 - the ORIGINAL non-reciprocal ER directive model
[8] E. M. Vitucci, N. Cenni, F. Fuschini, V. Degli-Esposti, 'A reciprocal heuristic model for diffuse scattering from walls and surfaces', IEEE TAP 71(7) 2023, pp. 6072-6083 - the RER fix

[9] G. Melloni, E. M. Vitucci, V. Degli-Esposti, S. Berweger, J. Chuang, C. Gentile, N. Golmie, 'A computationally efficient reciprocal effective roughness model for diffuse scattering', arXiv:2605.17988, 2026 - G-RER (NOT IN OUR ARCHIVE, see not_opened)

we_verified_against_the_installed_engine.fact: Sionna 2.0.1 ships LambertianPattern, BackscatteringPattern and DirectivePattern, all documented as 'from :cite:p:`Degli-Esposti07`'. The __call__ of BackscatteringPattern computes v_r = (0.5*(1+cos_psi_r))^alpha_r and v_i = (0.5*(1+cos_psi_i))^alpha_i with a normalisation over cos_theta_i. There is NO sqrt(cos theta_o) factor anywhere in the file.
we_verified_against_the_installed_engine.conclusion: Sionna's own diffuse-scattering kernel is the NON-reciprocal ER variant, not RER/G-RER. So 'our kernel violates reciprocity' is not a peculiarity of our PO layer - the stock engine we build on has the same property in its diffuse term, and the literature fix is a one-line sqrt(cos theta_s) reweighting plus renormalisation.

papers.title: Implementation of Physical Theory of Diffraction for Radar Cross Section Calculations
papers.authors: Alper Kursat Ozturk (MSc thesis, Bilkent University, Dept. of Electrical and Electronics Engineering)
papers.corpus: secondary (opened because it is the only document in 213 PDFs that states a reciprocity property OF PO ITSELF)

P8.verdict: ⭐⭐ THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT SENTENCE FOR OUR P8 CHAPTER. It says our defect is the textbook defect of PO, and that the remedy is the SAME remedy P4 needs.

quotes.q: PO theory also includes erroneous contribution due to abrupt discontinuities of current at the shadow boundaries of the surface. PO approximation is also expected to be inaccurate in the regions where the GO current does not produce the dominant scattering (e.g. deep shadow regions). Furthermore, fields in the PO approximation do not satisfy reciprocity except in the direction of specular reflection. PO becomes more inaccurate if the target surface contains edges. PTD is used to overcome this discrepancy.
In fact, PTD is the superposition of the PO field (originating from the smooth surface) and the field of the equivalent currents on the edge (edge-diffracted field).
The accuracy of the PO method depends on the size of the meshes. Triangles with area = 0.005 lambda^2 are used for meshing.

P8.why_this_closes_a_loop: P4 (band slope 0.74-1.70 dB/GHz vs measured 0.175-0.315, mechanism = missing frequency-independent edge term) and P8 (reciprocity violated off-specular) are THE SAME MISSING TERM. Adding PTD/edge currents is one fix that pays both. Our own plate check independently reproduces the PO obliquity law -20log10(cos beta) with residuals of 0.03-0.15 dB, which is what a correct PO implementation with the known defect should do. ⛔**대조 불가**(2026-09-04) — 측정 기울기 0.175~0.315 는 전부 **1.8~18.2 GHz 전대역 적합**이고 6 GHz 위 적합은 없다. 같은 구간에서 재면 우리 0.435 대 Das 0.210 = 2.07배다(`docs/ENGINE_VALIDATION.md` §1).
P8.caution: This is a 2002 MSc thesis, not a peer-reviewed article. Cite it as a secondary/textbook-level statement and back it with a primary source (Ufimtsev PTD, or McNamara/Pistorius/Malherbe UTD) before it goes in a paper. Its mesh criterion 0.005 lambda^2 per triangle is also a usable external number for our discretisation defence.

[13] combines PO simulation from CAD models in different positions to generate the time-varying reflectivity of a propelled aircraft. their_survey_of_how_others_did_rotation_.why_it_matters_for_us: ⭐ 512 discrete propeller positions over 360 deg is an established, twice-repeated sampling choice in the EM-solver literature. Our microdoppler_sbr uses n_phase=240 over the 180 deg period of a 2-blade prop = 480 equivalent positions per full turn. We are within 7% of the published convention and can now cite it instead of defending 240 from first principles.

their_reason_for_rejecting_that_route.q: These methods have the advantage of taking into account the complex structures of the objects and reproducing effects such as diffraction and shadowing. However, they are extremely time-consuming and hard to implement. As a consequence, using these methods to generate a large amount of data to train machine learning algorithms becomes unfeasible.

their_criticism_that_lands_on_US.q: This model also has another considerable advantage when compared to CAD-based EM simulation methods. It can easily reproduce the drone fast movements and rotations, with 3D velocity and 3D angular changes, which appear in practical scenarios, while vibration can be included with (46). ... These ranges and vectors can be independently recalculated for every slow-time instant t using any movement model. Hence, the proposed model enables the simulation of arbitrary target movements and complex trajectories, that can include varying accelerations and body rotation, which is not feasible with CAD-based EM simulations.
their_criticism_that_lands_on_US.our_answer: Our phase table is indexed by a SINGLE scalar phi = omega t because an n-blade rotor is invariant under 360/n rotation, so arbitrary rpm profiles are free (we resample the table). What is NOT free for us is arbitrary BODY attitude - each new body_rpy needs a new table. Costa's criticism is therefore half-true against us and should be stated that way, not dodged.

their_honest_limitation_we_should_quote.q: it is unfeasible to perform static reflectivity measurements for all possible geometric constellations, i.e., all possible combinations of bistatic angles.

error_bound_they_derived.q: the upper bound of the error in the calculation of the bistatic range is given by Err <= l^2/2 * (1/R_T + 1/R_R) ... we used l = 0.1655 m and R_T = R_R = 3.43 m. This case results in an error of range with upper bound of Err <= 8 mm, which represents a relative error of RErr <= 0.12% of the bistatic range.

P3_and_P8_jointly.convention_flag_for_us: Costa uses delta_R = c/[2B cos(beta/2)] (resolution ALONG THE BISECTOR). Our reports use delta_R_b = c/B (resolution in the bistatic range SUM). These are different quantities and both can be right; but report12 and report04 should say which one they mean, because a reviewer who knows Willis will check.

quote.q: The motion of AAV rotor blades can introduce RCS fluctuations through micro-Doppler effects [8], which are typically captured using coherent radar measurements and time-frequency processing [9]. Micro-Doppler can be incorporated in future extensions by augmenting the proposed RCS amplitude model with a Doppler term driven by rotor kinematics.

P3.did_anyone_express_rotation_INSIDE_the_e: NO. Across 140 Sionna-corpus PDFs plus 73 more from the secondary corpora, not one paper gives a rotating body a representation inside the tracer - no split-into-many-objects trick, no per-face velocity field, no time-varying transform evaluated by the solver. Sionna's own technical report (row 2, p.28) offers exactly two options and the accurate one is 'moving objects in small incremental steps ... and recomputing the propagation paths at each step'. Nobody beat that.
who_re_posed_per_snapshot: md-rt, ICCT 2025 (row 1) - INSIDE Sionna RT, 2048 OFDM symbols, Blender rotor mesh, plus a modified conical launcher. The only paper in the corpus that traced a rotating drone propeller.
VaN3Twin (row 4) - inside Sionna RT, translation only, with a published per-snapshot cost of 168-446 ms on an RTX 3090.
Open Wireless DT (row 5) - inside Sionna RT, translation only, and it warns that snapshotting alone leaves phase discontinuities between snapshots.

jees2021 MoM (row 14) and, per Costa's survey, refs [12]-[16] (PO+MEC helicopter rotor; PO on CAD at many positions; MoM+PO 512 positions; FEM/MoM 512 positions; full-wave over half a turn) - re-posed geometry in NON-ray engines. THESE ARE THE REAL PRECEDENT FOR pose_articulated().
P3.correction_to_our_own_record: ⭐ Our memory note says md-rt 'derives micro-Doppler analytically from rigid-body angular velocity'. That is HALF WRONG and should be fixed. The analytic omega x r formula is their VALIDATION REFERENCE (p.4: 'The simulated results are compared with the analytical formulas derived in Section II'); the simulation itself is a re-pose-and-re-trace loop in Sionna RT (p.3, steps 4-5). md-rt is therefore not a counterexample to our approach - it is the same approach, published, in the same engine.
P3.who_computed_micro_Doppler_in_Sionna_at_: Exactly one work: md-rt (ICCT 2025). OpenISAC has 21 micro-Doppler mentions but measures them on USRP hardware and cites Sionna only to say it is not an ISAC sensing pipeline. Ziganshin mentions micro-Doppler twice, both as future work. Clutter-Aware ISAC mentions it once, about human motion in indoor clutter. That is the whole list.
what_we_can_now_claim_that_we_could_not_: Our per-phase re-pose is the route the vendor documents as the accurate one, and the one-velocity-vector shortcut is documented as valid only for trajectories of a few wavelengths - a rotor tip exceeds that inside one OFDM slot.
Our n_phase=240 over the 360/n_blades period (=480 per full turn) sits beside a twice-published convention of 512 positions per 360 deg.

The rotate-the-source-instead-of-the-object equivalence, the CW/CCW mirror relation and the far-field per-rotor phase sum - all three of our optimisations - are a published method (JEES 2021) with a measured 157x speedup and <2% NRMSD penalty.

P8.who_computed_bistatic_scattering_in_a_ra: One: Ziganshin (rows 7-8), in both documents. Sagitta (row 11) is a ray engine that deliberately stayed monostatic and said in a footnote that bistatic would require the exit-visibility function. Everything else labelled 'bistatic' in the corpus is a signal model or a measurement, not a ray-traced scattering kernel.
P8.did_anyone_check_reciprocity_or_symmetry: NO ONE checked their own kernel. Zero papers in 213 PDFs report a reciprocity or symmetry test on a scattering computation they performed. Ziganshin, the only bistatic ray-tracing author, has 0 occurrences of 'reciproc' in 11 pages; he bought credibility with EXTERNAL data instead (BIRA bistatic measurement 2-18 GHz, MLFMM in the shadow region).
external_standards_that_DO_exist: ⭐ 2605.31267 (row 9): the reciprocity condition written as an equation for a scattering pattern, f(k_s,k_i)/F(k_i) cos(theta_i) = f(k_i,k_s)/F(k_s) cos(theta_s), the identification of the classical ER directive model as NON-reciprocal, and the RER fix (a sqrt(cos theta_s) factor, Vitucci et al. IEEE TAP 71(7) 2023). It also states that Sionna RT ships the ER family - and we verified in the installed 2.0.1 source that Sionna's DirectivePattern has no sqrt(cos theta_o) factor, i.e. it is the NON-reciprocal variant.

⭐ Bilkent MSc thesis 2002 (row 10) p.70: 'fields in the PO approximation do not satisfy reciprocity except in the direction of specular reflection ... PTD is used to overcome this discrepancy.' This says our violation is the expected behaviour of PO and that P4 and P8 share one cure.
Das, IEEE WCL 15 (2026) (row 15): measured drone RCS at bistatic angles 0:15:90 deg, 1.8-27 GHz; going to beta=90 costs only 1-2 dB of angle-averaged mean RCS.

our_window_in_that_light.our_own_data: reciprocity RMS is 2.82 dB already at beta=15 and 5.69 dB at beta=90 (15 drone-band cells); the mean Delta sigma at beta=90 is -2.15 dB
our_window_in_that_light.external_comparison: Das measures 1-2 dB from mono to beta=90 on real airframes; our -2.15 dB agrees. So the ANGLE-AVERAGED LEVEL is in family. The reciprocity RMS is a different and larger error, and no external paper bounds it, because no one measured it.
our_window_in_that_light.recommended_reframing: Stop presenting beta<=45 as a measured knee. Present it as: (i) PO is known not to be reciprocal off specular (Bilkent/PTD literature); (ii) our plate check reproduces the closed-form obliquity law -20log10(cos beta) to within 0.03-0.15 dB, so the kernel behaves as PO should; (iii) exit visibility, which Sagitta says bistatic requires and which we implemented, cuts the drone-level violation from 6.11 to 4.02 dB RMS at beta=90; (iv) the residual is the missing edge term, and PTD is the named remedy for both P4 and P8.

cheapest_next_experiments_suggested_by_t: Apply the RER sqrt(cos theta_s) reweighting + renormalisation to any diffuse term we take from Sionna, and re-run multistatic_check. The literature says this makes the pattern exactly reciprocal; our harness already measures whether it does.

Symmetrise: outputs/sbr_defect_fixes.json already stores sigma_sym (geometric mean of the two directions) with rms_sym_db = 0 by construction. A reciprocity-enforcing symmetrised kernel is one line and is defensible under Van Bladel; state it as a modelling choice, not as physics.
Add a PTD/edge term on the airframe silhouette and check BOTH the band slope (P4) and the reciprocity RMS (P8) move together. If they do, that is a single-mechanism result worth a figure.

cautions: Two document pairs must never be merged: Ziganshin EuCAP 2025 (published, carries the runtime sentence) vs arXiv:2604.05991v2 (preprint, does not); Costa RadarConf24 (single propeller) vs JSTEAP 2025 (multi-propeller, measured). Both pairs are physically present in the archive as separate files.
Clutter-Aware ISAC also exists twice (Proc. IEEE PDF and arXiv:2602.10537v2). The micro-Doppler machine count of 6 files is 5 unique works for this reason.

'Reciprocal filter' is the dominant meaning of 'reciproc' in this literature (passive-radar range compression, OFDM de-randomization). Ten of the eleven hits in the Sionna corpus are that, or DL/UL channel reciprocity. Only one is scattering reciprocity. Any future keyword search must apply this filter or it will produce exactly the kind of false count this workflow exists to prevent.
Rows 13, 19 and 20 were NOT read page by page and say so. Their P3/P8 entries rest on machine counts plus, where noted, a published characterisation by another author.

The Das (row 15) agreement is on an ANGLE-AVERAGED mean over 360 azimuths at 1.8-27 GHz versus our 24 azimuths at 1.8-5.2 GHz. It corroborates the level trend with bistatic angle. It does NOT validate our per-aspect pattern and must not be written up as if it did.
